QUOTE: Under the shipped config, `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_STD_CALLOC` is off (`include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:4124`). In that case the calloc pointer starts as `platform_calloc_uninit` (`library/platform.c:25-30`), which always returns `NULL`. So any allocation fails until something installs an allocator.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the uninitialised calloc returns NULL, but it never says that the uninitialised free does nothing, and the item needs both halves.
